subject: Pilot credit bridge & pricing package for FirstLight cohort
messages:
From: Sara Lindstrom <sara@firstlight.vc>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@firstlight.vc
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff + ask for extra credits while cohort starts

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the founders walked away excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. We kick off our next cohort on July 6 and have a small group doing product-market fit experiments that need a short-term bump in credits.

The ask: can Redwood extend an additional 75k free token credits split across 10 teams for the first 6 weeks as a pilot bridge? Our typical accelerator benefit is a one-time credit grant, but a subset of teams are running high-volume synthetic load tests and will consume far more than the standard allotment in the first month.

If you need context I attached the cohort list and a short scope doc. We can share performance expectations and a short mutual action plan if helpful. This would be a one-off promotional exception—if this works well we expect a few cohort teams to convert to paid Dedicated capacity later (we can include that intent in the MOU).

Appreciate any flexibility — timing is tight given July kickoff. Happy to hop on a 20-min call today or tomorrow.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lindstrom
Programs Director | FirstLight Accelerator
ops@firstlight.vc

Attachments: FirstLight_Cohort_List.xlsx (spreadsheet), Pilot_Scope_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff + ask for extra credits while cohort starts

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and the attachments.

Short answer: we can support a credit bridge for high-intensity pilot teams, but I need to align internally on scope and an approval path for an exception of that size. Can you confirm: 1) the list of 10 teams that will receive the credits, 2) expected token consumption profiles per team (rough buckets — e.g., 5–10k tokens/day), and 3) whether any of these teams will require PII/data residency constraints?

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll loop in Dev (solutions) and Marissa (growth) to draft a short mutual action plan and a one-page MOU with conversion language.
- If we can get the team list + usage estimate today, I’ll push this through pricing committee for a temporary exception.

I’m available 4–4:30pm PT today for a quick call if that helps.

Thanks — looking forward to making this smooth for your cohort.

—Sean

From: dev.patel@redwood.ai <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Sara Lindstrom <sara@firstlight.vc>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff + ask for extra credits while cohort starts

Hi all — looping in some suggested guardrails and a pricing path. Thanks, Sean, for flagging.

Summary of proposal (internal):
- One-time bridge: 75,000 token credits total, allocated as 7.5k credits per team (10 teams) for the first 6 weeks.
- Conditional clause: credits consumed beyond allocation billed at a 40% promotional discount off our standard hosted rates for the remainder of the cohort (up to 3 months).
- Eligibility: teams must be part of the attached cohort list and agree to a short usage feedback survey at weeks 2 and 6.
- Conversion incentive: if a team converts to Redwood Dedicated within 3 months, Redwood will provide a one-time top-up credit equal to 10% of first-month committed spend.

Why this is reasonable: the one-time grant preserves unit economics while the discounted overage gives visibility into sustained usage. The feedback survey lets us prioritize product improvements and surfaced quality issues early.

Next ask for Redwood pricing committee: an exception signoff for the 75k grant and authorization to offer the 40% promotional overage discount. I’ve attached a draft pricing proposal for review (pricing_proposal_redwood_draft.pdf).

Sara — could you confirm whether teams will run synthetic load tests that generate >50k tokens/day each (so we can model peak capacity)? Also please confirm no special data residency requirements.

Happy to take a call to walk through the financials.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: pricing_proposal_redwood_draft.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: dev.patel@redwood.ai, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Sara Lindstrom <sara@firstlight.vc>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff + ask for extra credits while cohort starts

Folks — I reviewed the draft and spoke briefly with finance. We can approve a time-limited promotional exception with the following firm conditions:

1) Approve the 75k total bridge credits distributed as proposed.
2) Approve the 40% promotional overage discount for the cohort for up to 3 months.
3) Require signed MOU (simple one-page) that includes: cohort list, usage reporting cadence, conversion intent clause, and liability/disallowed-content acknowledgement.
4) Limit: promotional credits expire 8 weeks after issuance. Any usage after that period billed at promotional overage rates.

Sean — please generate the MOU and the one-page summary for Sara. Dev — finance wants the expected spend delta modeled; can you send a short estimate (expected overage $) by EOD tomorrow so we can close the loop?

Sara — welcome aboard — we’ll fast-track setup and issue credits once we have the signed MOU and the team list with expected usage. We can draft the MOU and share it in the next 24 hours.

Appreciate the clear ask — good opportunity to demonstrate value to cohort teams.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Growth | Redwood Inference
